lascala/com.phasmidsoftware.lascala/com.phasmidsoftware.lascala.cache/Expiring

Expiring

com.phasmidsoftware.lascala.cache.Expiring
trait Expiring[K]

This trait defines the mechanism for expiring a value from the cache, that's to say the removal of the value. It doesn't say anything about scheduling an expiration.

CONSIDER renaming this trait to MutableCache, or some such name.

K

the key for this expiring object
